Hero_Desc_Silphir:
A sapphire dragon who always aims for the top spot and challenges the ranks.
She may look like an underdog, but she is actually of an incredibly high rank.
She is a flawless apostle apart from her obsession with ranks.
Album_Like_Silphir: Sapphire. Rewards earned after hard work.
Album_Silphir1: The self-proclaimed shadow leader among the dragons. It's a pity she shows such an obsession to the implicit hierarchy among the dragons.
Album_Silphir2: Despite from her calm outer appearance, Silphir has a surprisingly frivolous personality. The only time she is serious is when talking to Daya, the leader of the dragons.
Album_Silphir3: When she meets with Rudd, she becomes more talkative than usual. Her intense, distorted rivalry with Rudd is so palpable that other dragons can feel it too.
Album_Silphir4: In truth, Silphir's power and ability doesn't seem to be less than Rudd's. However, because of her flighty expressions, others see her as mediocre at best.
Album_Silphir5: It seems Silphir silly personality is not her only drawback. Among the dragons, she's the most welcoming to outsiders. Maybe it's because she's so naive, you can tell she's the type to easily fall for the most obvious scams.
Album_Silphir6: Silphir often enjoys going to the lake on the surface. When she submerges her blue body into the azure lake, she says her mood lifts because she looks transparent, like a diamond.
Album_Silphir7: I found out Silphir has another insecurity. The name she uses now is an alias. Her real name is "Lazuli." She made me promise to keep this a secret, saying she only tells her real name to the ones she trusts the most.

LoveLetter_Silphir: Rudd's been bugging me lately, telling me I should work out more. Hmph. As if just lifting weights is the answer for everything.That's why I want you to help with my training, Master. N-Not because I want to see you or anything, okay? It's just that you're the best fit for this. Seriously! I'll let you know my training schedule, so make sure you're on time.
LoveCall_Silphir:
Master! It is me, Silphir.
You have time today, right? I will show you the technique I trained, so meet me in front of the Order.
...H-Hmm? Do you really have to inspect it every time? They all look similar?!
T-Tch! Hey! They are completely different! I have never shown you the same technique twice!
Y-You know I absolutely did not contact you simply because I wanted to see your face, right?!
I called you to inspect the results of my training, so do not get any strange ideas!
...But in that case...
Even though you can never tell the difference, you still come out and watch every time I contact you?
Well... I-I am grateful for that...
Nnngh! But inspect them properly from now on!
Part of this may be because I want to see you, but it is also because I have to defeat that Rude!!
...Huh? Wh-What did I just say...
N-Nngyaaa! Ah, forget it! I am hanging up!!
